calculation.expression: (return_20d.shift(10) - return_10d) / rolling_std(return_1d,20), lagged by 1 completed session
calculation.description: Contrarian cross-asset signal measuring deterioration of the recent 10-session trend relative to the preceding 10 sessions, scaled by 20-session volatility. Positive values favor assets whose trend has decelerated and whose subsequent return is expected to mean-revert. All inputs are lagged to avoid look-ahead.

validation.regime_notes: Validation spans multiple historical regimes in the 15-instrument cross-asset benchmark. IC uncertainty is interpreted conservatively because the cross-section is small. Signal is exactly the sign inverse of the concurrently explored acceleration artifact, so it should not be treated as independent evidence.
